look.text: Ticket office at night: wooden counter, brass ticket window with a roll-down shutter above it, felt coin tray, wall clock, glass door left, suitcase in the booth
invariants: wooden counter with a brass-framed ticket window
glass entrance door on the left
worn brown suitcase behind the counter
environment_rules: rain only at the glass door

objects.label: wooden counter
objects.placement: the barrier between the clerk booth and the public hall, waist-high, with a glass screen rising from it

objects.label: brass-framed ticket window
objects.placement: a plain rectangular opening set into the glass screen on top of the counter, the only opening between clerk and customer

objects.label: roll-down shutter
objects.placement: mounted on the booth side of the ticket window, directly above it inside its brass frame; lowered, it covers the window glass from behind
objects.operation: pulled down and pushed up by fingers hooked under its bottom edge, from inside the booth

objects.label: brass shutter catches
objects.placement: two small brass stop blocks on the inner sides of the ticket window's brass frame, level with each other at the clerk's chest height; the lowered shutter's bottom edge rests on them

objects.label: felt coin tray
objects.placement: on the counter under the ticket window, reachable from both sides

objects.label: round wall clock
objects.placement: on the back wall of the clerk booth, to the right of the ticket window, seen through the glass screen

objects.label: green-shaded desk lamp
objects.placement: on the clerk's desk behind the counter, the warm light of the booth

objects.label: worn brown suitcase
objects.placement: on the floor of the clerk booth by the back wall, visible behind the clerk

objects.label: glass door to the platform
objects.placement: in the left wall of the public hall, rain streaking its glass

cameras.view: Camera in the public hall at a customer's eye level, facing the ticket window; through its glass, the clerk booth and its back wall
Camera inside the clerk booth behind the clerk, facing out through the ticket window to the public hall and the glass door
Camera in the public hall, side-on to the counter: the customer's side on the left, the clerk behind the ticket window on the right

look.text: Station platform at night in light rain: one lamp post, a wooden bench, a timetable board, wet rails, the ticket office door in the station wall
invariants: ticket office door in the station wall

zones.label: track side (rails and the arriving train)

objects.label: single lamp post
objects.placement: standing on the platform near the ticket office wall, its light falling on the wet platform

objects.label: painted wooden bench
objects.placement: against the ticket office wall, away from the platform edge

objects.label: timetable board
objects.placement: on the ticket office wall beside the office door

objects.label: train doors
objects.placement: the doors of the last train, stopped alongside the platform edge, sliding open onto the platform

cameras.view: Camera on the platform at head height, wide, looking along the platform: the ticket office wall with its door and the lamp post on one side, the platform edge, the wet rails and the train headlights on the other
Camera on the platform at head height, medium, side-on to the pair at the platform edge, facing the train: the open train doors and their light behind the two of them
